preconditions.description: The dimensions of the map must be within the specified bounds.
The maximum number of different types of squares that can be visited must be between 1 and 4.

preconditions.expression: any('S' in row for row in map) and any('T' in row for row in map)
preconditions.description: The map must contain exactly one starting square 'S' and one terminating square 'T'.

postconditions.description: If no valid path exists, the output must be '-1' or an empty string.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout) == len(path) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output must be a sequence of lowercase letters representing the path.
The number of different types of squares visited in the path must not exceed k.
